name: QSMEF
description: QSMEF (Quantum Software Engineering Module Evaluation Framework) is a framework for evaluating the functional contributions of components in quantum software. This software release provides a Python validator, documentation, and reproducible results for five quantum software case studies: SKW quantum walk search, QAOA–MaxCut, TwoLocal–H₂, QPE/Shor, and Minimum Bisection. The framework uses a Hermitian observable to define a functional evaluation metric and Shapley values to attribute contributions to individual components. The validator assesses technical validity and applicability under declared functional constraints. The repository includes experimental results, applicability assessments, and a comparison of the original and modified SKW oracle. Source code: https://github.com/QSMEF/QSMEF-Journal-2026 Version: 1.0.0
